item.title: Exclusive Interview: UK’s First Fully Open Access University Press: ‘All our books have been downloaded at least 700 times’
item.description: Lara Speicher is Publishing Manager of UCL Press, the UK’s first fully open access (OA) university press, where she has spent the last two years setting up the Press from scratch. Speicher will be speaking on the Publishing Technology-curated panel entitled ‘What is a Publisher Now? Yes, it’s Open: But Where on Earth is it?’...
